documents.body:
# payments

The payments platform hosts two services:

- **billing-api** creates invoices and charges customers.
- **ledger-service** records balances and journal entries.

Both services are owned by team-payments. Local development uses docker-compose
(see `docker-compose.yml`); production infrastructure lives in `infra/`.

billing-api caches user sessions in memcached.

Runbook: page the payments on-call for incidents affecting invoice creation.
documents.title: acme/payments README

documents.body:
apiVersion: backstage.io/v1alpha1
kind: Component
metadata:
  name: billing-api
  description: Creates invoices and charges customers
spec:
  type: service
  owner: team-payments
  system: payments
  dependsOn:
    - resource:payments-db
  consumesApis:
    - fx-rates-api
---
apiVersion: backstage.io/v1alpha1
kind: Component
metadata:
  name: ledger-service
spec:
  type: service
  owner: team-payments
  system: payments
  dependsOn:
    - resource:payments-db
  providesApis:
    - ledger-api

# ADR 0007: Store ledger balances in PostgreSQL

Status: Accepted (2024-03-12)

## Context

ledger-service needs transactional, double-entry writes with strong consistency.
We evaluated DynamoDB and PostgreSQL.

## Decision

ledger-service stores balances and journal entries in PostgreSQL, in the shared
payments-db instance, using serializable transactions.

## Consequences

payments-db becomes a dependency of both billing-api and ledger-service.
documents.title: docs/adr/0007-ledger-on-postgres.md

# ADR 0002: One SQS queue per domain

Status: Accepted (2023-11-02)

## Decision

Each domain publishes events to its own SQS queue created from the shared
sqs-queue Terraform module in acme/terraform-modules. Queues are not shared
across domains.
